question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no.1.**
solution:
The correct answer is "**assume**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **theme **of the passage is how **technological advancements **have come at the **cost **of **nature **which has led to rising **environmental diseases**.
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given options.
 
• **Assume**: suppose to be the case, without proof.
 
• **Grasp**: seize and hold firmly.
 
• **Receive**: be given, presented with, or paid (something).
 
• **Become**: grow to be; develop into.
 
• The word **assume **is the most appropriate option according to the meaning in the given context.
 
 
• **Example**: *How can you **assume **__that I am a shallow person?*
 
 

**Thus, the correct answer is option 1**

**The complete passage is:-** *Nature has been suffering mutely for hundreds of years but the problem did not **(1)assume** serious proportions so long as the damage was **(2)containable** and not beyond self-repair. These limits were crossed with **(3)spectacular** technological breakthroughs accomplished during the recent years. The developed nations **(4)which** benefitted most from these were the first to **(5)encounter** the environmental diseases bred by advanced technology.*
